Volumes bill on provisioned capacity, not usage.

First 10GB of snapshots free each month. Every app gets a shared IPv4 and unlimited Anycast IPv6.


### Sprites pricing

![](https://fly.io/phx/ui/images/pricing/compute-blue-62a80cd6eec870426a4baa184e066f5e.png?vsn=d)

#### Sprites Compute

Metered per hour of active use.


| Resource | Rate |
| --- | --- |
| CPU timeCumulative CPU usage measured by cpu.stat | $0.0385 / CPU-hour |
| Memory timeActual memory usage | $0.021875 / GB-hour |

![](https://fly.io/phx/ui/images/pricing/storage-blue-e1f3d5f7a05e80c5baef3067a5893610.png?vsn=d)

#### Sprites Storage

Billed in GB-hours at two rates, which differ in when they stop.


| Tier | Rate | Per GB-month |
| --- | --- | --- |
| HotBills while the Sprite is awake | $0.000683 / GB-hour | $0.50 |
| ColdBills for as long as you keep it | $0.000027 / GB-hour | $0.02 |

Per-month figures are the hourly rate over a 730-hour month.


Billed hourly, with nothing to pick up front


CPU, memory and hot storage bill while a Sprite is awake. Cold storage bills until you delete the data.


[Estimate your usage](https://fly.io/calculator/)

#### Managed Postgres Storage

Billed on the storage your databases use, for a 30-day month.


| Item | Price |
| --- | --- |
| Database storage, per GB | $0.28 |
| Example: 10GB used | $2.80 / mo |

Creating or deleting a cluster mid-month is prorated. Same-region transfer is free.

## Support

Community support is free and always has been. The paid plans add an easily nerd-sniped support team that feels like an extension of your own.


![](https://fly.io/phx/ui/images/pricing/support-standard-0cdf1837b52c13b693360a74f61f4509.png?vsn=d)

### Standard

$29 / mo

Basic support for single developers and small teams. Great for personal projects and startups.

- 36-hour first response time
- Technical architecture support

![](https://fly.io/phx/ui/images/pricing/support-premium-9eafe970b77b1b97747c050639d60489.png?vsn=d)

### Premium

$199 / mo

Enhanced support for growing businesses. Ideal for scaling applications and teams.

- 24-hour first response time
- 1-hour first response for urgent issues
- Dedicated Slack support channel
- Quarterly Solutions Architecture sessions

![](https://fly.io/phx/ui/images/pricing/support-enterprise-40c3c3445f029ff492ec242256a243c6.png?vsn=d)

### Enterprise

From $2,500 / mo

Top-tier support for large-scale operations. Perfect for mission-critical apps and enterprise deployments.

- 4-hour first response time, 24x7
- 15-minute emergency first response, 24x7
- Dedicated Slack support channel
- Quarterly Solutions Architecture sessions
- 99.9% uptime SLA

![](https://fly.io/phx/ui/images/pricing/compliance-cbcdfffd144e923847660e5f07baa254.png?vsn=d)
